items.title: City’s CFO Resigns Rather Than ‘Compromise My Integrity,’ Sparking Calls For Investigation
items.description: Ashlee Gabrysch took the role in August. Her resignation comes in the middle of yet another budget stalemate between the City Council and Mayor Brandon Johnson.

items.title: Peoples Gas Customers To See $56 Back In November Bill Credits
items.description: The credits come from a $125 million settlement reached with the attorney general’s office.

items.title: Ald. William Hall Is Running Against 2 Challengers In 6th Ward Race — For Now
items.description: Hall will compete against Allyson Renee Scrutchens and Curtiss Llong Bey, though the incumbent alderman and Llong Bey both face challenges to their nominating petitions.

items.title: Ald. Ruth Cruz Faces 1 Challenger In 30th Ward Race
items.description: Cruz, who was elected to her first term in 2023, is being challenged by Juritzy “Judy” Velez, a 14-year resident of the ward.

items.title: Anthony Beale, Longtime Far South Side Alderman, Faces 2 Challengers In 9th Ward Race
items.description: Beale is seeking his eighth term, and he's up against Kenny Williams and Cecelia Harrison.

items.title: Here Are The 3 Finalists For Chicago’s Next Top Cop
items.description: Antoinette Ursitti, Christopher Papaioannou and Angel Novalez are high-ranking police officials. If chosen by Mayor Brandon Johnson, Ursitti would be the first woman to lead the Chicago Police Department.

items.title: South Park Terrace, A Frank Lloyd Wright-Inspired Apartment Complex In Washington Park, Up For Auction
items.description: Preservationists and a court-appointed receiver are calling for a buyer to restore the neglected 52-unit property. Bids will start at $100,000.

items.title: Is CPD’s Domestic Violence Program Working? Alders Finally Hold Hearing As Need Skyrockets
items.description: The first hearing on the matter was canceled after only eight alderpeople showed up. The new hearing comes after a Block Club investigation revealed the city put $3.9 million into a police program that has produced few results.
